references.title: Google Street View, Bulevardi 13, April2023 leafless adjacent facade view
Google Street View, Bulevardi13 actual front, August2024

observations: Actual August2024 front and April2023 oblique show muted olive gray plaster, dark reddish brown multi-light frames, a dark granite shop base and broad glazing.
Asymmetric projecting bays and a tall rounded turret remain the municipal geometry; tall rectangular upper openings have divided upper transoms and subtle pale surrounds.
Opening spacing and partially tree-occluded upper rows are an explicit architectural approximation; no photographed leaves or signage are baked into the new art.
limitations: Only exact outward southeast street-front facets and their connected forward-facing bay/turret facets are selected; roof and side/courtyard walls retain native materials.

Window dimensions, spacing and balcony drawing are reference-led approximations, not a measured elevation survey. Street View photos are appearance references only; no pixels, people, trees or commercial branding are copied.
Both current official appearance themes lack images for this exact source building; no2017model or theme is used.
